analogy.rationale: FLT3 inhibitors are ATP-competitive tyrosine kinase inhibitors whose annotated targets (FLT3, CSF1R, KIT, PDGFRA/B, RET) overlap with other receptor tyrosine kinase inhibitors, so the closest transcriptional analogs are broad tyrosine kinase inhibitors and VEGFR/PDGFR/KIT inhibitors. Because these cell lines express little FLT3, the response is expected to be weak.
